title: Choose your work context
description: Your account can access multiple customer environments or HR groups. Select the environment and group you want to work in.
visualBody: LiquidHR tailors the information and features shown to the customer environment and HR group you select.
visualPointAccess: You can choose from contexts your account can access.
visualPointContext: The selected HR group determines which information is available.
visualPointPermissions: Your existing access permissions remain in effect.
formDescription: Choose where you want to work in this session.
contextNote: LiquidHR uses your choice to show the related information and features.
noAccess: No active HR context is available.
failed: The context could not be saved. Choose again.
invalid: Select a valid customer environment and HR group.
